title: fix(dreamshaper): keep the requested aspect ratio when capping the size
author: lotxo1

gist.summary: Fixed DreamShaper’s `clamp_dims()` so oversized image requests keep approximately their requested aspect ratio instead of capping width and height separately. A single scale factor now respects both `MAX_DIM` and `MAX_PIXELS`: 1920×1080 becomes 672×384 rather than 512×512, while requests already under both caps remain unchanged. Dimensions still round down to multiples of 32 with a 32 px floor, so ratios can shift slightly. Added tests for wide, tall, square, under-cap, long-side-cap, and zero-size inputs.
